> [!CAUTION]
> The consumer version of Gemini Code Assist on GitHub has been sunset. All code review activity has officially ceased.

performed_via_github_app.name: Gemini Code Assist
performed_via_github_app.description:
**Accelerate code reviews and improve code quality**

Bring the power of [Gemini](https://gemini.google.com/) directly to GitHub, providing AI-powered code reviews on your pull requests, with automatic pull request summaries, ready-to-commit code suggestions and the ability to invoke Gemini for assistance at any point on the PR.

This app is only available for Google Cloud customers. Follow the [setup instructions](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/docs/code-review/set-up-code-assist-github) to get started.

## Independent exact-head review — FAIL

Bound to live PR head `50146c7710430fe64b8ee875d107b14baae648f5`, tree `64e3c3bb4e5b6717f472a7f1ce174e8420363666`. I fetched the live head into a fresh detached worktree, reread #1798, #1804, and this PR, and re-fetched immediately before this verdict. The live SHA/tree remained unchanged.

### Blocking finding

- **Required producer/runtime independence suite is 30/31, not 31/31.** `scripts/vlm/__tests__/issue_1766_future_semantic_kg_producer.test.py::FutureSemanticKgProducerTests::test_producer_runtime_implementations_remain_independent` fails because `P6_BOUNDED_AUTHORITY_OUTPUTS` does not include the eight new terminal artifacts. The assertion reports all eight as unexpected artifacts. This contradicts the PR body and Chinese report claim of 31/31 PASS and the checked-in readback hard gate `producer_runtime_validator_implementation_sharing = 0`. Add the exact eight bounded P6-06 output paths to the focused authority whitelist, rerun the full 31-test file, and keep the repair in this PR. A fresh-head review is required after the head changes.

### Evidence independently authenticated

- Live #1799–#1803 states are CLOSED. PRs #1806–#1812 are MERGED and form the exact contiguous seven-PR chain recorded by the release, including delayed repairs #1808 and #1810. Reviewed head trees and merge transitions match the builder constants.
- All five immutable Family delta/visual-ledger SHA-256 values, the P6-01 inventory, active P6-05 manifest/projection, structural/P5 authority pins, and historical predecessor non-mutation were independently checked. The PR adds only the eight terminal outputs, report/index, builder, and focused test.
- Terminal/rollback receipts and all eight file hashes/byte lengths match the Chinese report. Deterministic builder `--check` reports PASS for rebuild and active/terminal/rollback replay.
- Conservation and isolation match: 42 papers, 286/286 Questions, 920/920 QuestionParts, 686 score-owning, 234 instruction-only, all five P6 topics represented, 482 approved / 160 candidate / 278 abstain / 0 rejected; candidate/abstain boundaries expose zero ProcedureInstances or steps. Epoch scope is 2020–2025, components 61/62/63, source title Paper 6 Statistics 2, with zero pre-2020 S1 admission or invented Paper 7 rows.
- Graph checks match: 45 QuestionTypes, 42 canonical ProcedureModels, 763 unique ProcedureInstances, 2,394 unique contiguous steps, 269 supporting instances, 12 alternatives across 9 parts, no dangling refs, and no duplicate embedded model definitions. All 200 cross-P5 instances reuse 9 models whose definitions and byte-length/path/SHA-256 receipts match exact approved P5 terminal authority.
- All three P6 singleton models have explicit syllabus/MS exception rationales. The risk ledger contains deterministic samples for every official Family, both scope exceptions, all 10 status changes, all 12 alternative branches, 200 cross-P5 instances, and bounded sets for graph/piecewise-density, Poisson/binomial boundaries, estimator/CI, and hypothesis-tail cases.

### Independent original-pixel review

I opened all 20 unique required QP/MS crops at original detail for the 10 rejected-to-approved reconciliations. The images are readable and hash-bound. The visible semantics support the terminal dispositions: S25/62 q01/a requires an unambiguous two-die-faces-per-student allocation; S25/62 q05 is an upper-tail 5% normal sample-mean boundary with unchanged sigma, z = 1.645, and x-bar = 12.5; the W20 q02 duplicates visibly cover confidence interval, unbiased estimates, and sampling bias; the W21 q06 duplicates visibly cover unbiased normal estimates. No visual semantic mismatch was found.

### Commands and outcomes

- `issue_1804_p6_terminal_reconciliation.test.py`: 13/13 PASS
- `issue_1803_p6_hypothesis_tests_semantic_kg.test.py`: 10/10 PASS
- `issue_1791_p5_terminal_reconciliation.test.py`: 12/12 PASS
- `issue_1766_future_semantic_kg_producer.test.py`: **30/31, FAIL**
- terminal builder `--check`: PASS
- `npm run quality:report-index`: PASS, 0 violations
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`: PASS

**Verdict: FAIL, one ordinary substantive blocker.** Semantic/visual/custody review found no additional blocker, but the required producer suite and the corresponding checked-in PASS claim must be reconciled before merge.

Addressed the exact-head blocker in commit 84257999e2773ff3a65669ec904a068eb8b55e9f (tree 7f17d62a0c6d31aee564570ab27dfc91a7a6696e).

The focused P6_BOUNDED_AUTHORITY_OUTPUTS contract now lists exactly the eight bounded P6-06 terminal artifacts. The existing unexpected-artifact rejection and runtime non-mutation assertions remain unchanged.
